notes: This file is read by learn/cycle.py and never written by it. Loosening a threshold is a human decision.
Candidates are a fixed menu of parameter and feature-set choices; the cycle cannot invent features or edit code.
The decision uses the selection seasons only. The prospective ledger (forecasts saved before kickoff) is the final evaluation and is never used to choose a model.
report_holdout=false keeps the 2025 holdout out of routine cycles so it is not tuned against repeatedly.
